proposed_widenings.name: CreatedObjectDurability.damageResistances
proposed_widenings.justification: The tower has Resistance to all damage types not explicitly immunized. CreatedObjectDurability only supports damageImmunities and damageVulnerabilities; there is no damageResistances field.

proposed_widenings.name: CreatedObjectDurability.damageImmunities with exception filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The tower's B/P/S immunity has a siege-equipment exception. The current damageImmunities field is a flat list with no mechanism for source-based exceptions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage except that which is dealt by siege equipment.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor: rectangular_prism
proposed_widenings.justification: The tower is 20 ft on a side and 30 ft high — a rectangular prism, not a cube. No AreaShapeSpec variant captures different width and height dimensions. Encoded as cube {sideFeet=20} covering only the base footprint.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The tower is 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high.

proposed_widenings.name: ResetCadence: on_created_object_reverted
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be redeployed after the tower is reverted to statuette form. No existing reset cadence models 'refills when the previously-created object is manually dismissed.' Using { kind: 'never' } as a placeholder, which incorrectly implies the tower can only be created once ever.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger: source_issues_revert_command
proposed_widenings.justification: The permanent tower ends when the attunee repeats the command word (if the tower is empty). The existing permanent.endsOn only accepts 'dispel' | 'damage'; manual-command revert is not representable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move to nearest unoccupied space outside area
proposed_widenings.justification: Creatures in the tower's footprint are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside and adjacent to it. Current force_move requires a fixed distanceFeet value; 'nearest valid space outside a specified area' is a different spatial algorithm. Omitted from encoding.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower.

proposed_widenings.name: control_created_object_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: The door of the created tower can be opened and closed via a Bonus Action command by the attunee. There is no v4 atom or surface mechanism for commanding a feature (door, hatch, etc.) of a previously-created object. negate_named_effect exists but attaches to a creature or spell effect, not to a structural property of a created object.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The door opens only at your command, which you can issue as a Bonus Action. It is immune to the Knock spell and similar magic.

notes: Core mechanic (activation → create_object with durability) encodes cleanly and traces correctly. The trace omits: (1) damage resistances on the tower (field missing from CreatedObjectDurability), (2) siege-equipment immunity exception (no exception mechanism), (3) tower height in shape (no rectangular-prism AreaShapeDescriptor), (4) force-push of creatures on creation (non-fixed displacement), (5) revert mechanic and its reset-cadence refill, (6) door control via Bonus Action. The resetCadence: 'never' placeholder in the dhall is acknowledged as semantically wrong — it represents the missing 'on_reverted' cadence, not true single-use exhaustion.
